summary: BrenX Ltd., an Israeli thermal-energy-storage issuer, furnished a 6-K disclosing a September 15, 2026 settlement with the European Investment Bank cancelling its March 2021 credit facility. After a €1.1 million initial payment and satisfaction of closing conditions, roughly $4.8 million of EIB debt is eliminated, outstanding amounts waived, and equipment and receivables pledges released, subject to a potential €2.9 million contingent payment. Management estimates pro forma June 30, 2026 liabilities fall about 54% to $4.1 million and equity rises about 77% to $8.2 million. The US-equivalent filing is a current report on Form 8-K. Watch closing conditions and the contingent payment.
